amountSemantics: modeled marginal donor expenditure, not a verified funding offer
formula: 10 * costPerSupportedInitiation / (additionality * coveredYears * untreatedAnnualMortality * (1 - mortalityHazardRatio) * transferRetention * qalysPerDeath)

anchors.agreementStatus: May 2026 proposal; subject to budget finalization, not proof of execution

judgments.label: Donor cost per supported initiation
judgments.basis: Ten assumed service hours * $279.32 shared-service budget benchmark = $2,793.20. The broad SFAF bundle is not an HYA-specific marginal rate. Includes failed engagement effort allocated over initiations; not ten hours of prescriber time.

judgments.label: Additional uptake and funding
judgments.basis: 50% jointly allows alternative treatment access and replacement of existing finance. Conditional on prescriber and pharmacy capacity.

judgments.label: Medication-covered years per initiation
judgments.basis: Three months is a judgment informed loosely by intermittent SF retention, not an area calculated from sparse observations. Active prescriptions do not prove adherence. No extra completion multiplier is applied.

judgments.label: Untreated annual mortality rate
judgments.basis: 5% is transferred from an older Massachusetts adult overdose-survivor cohort; youth baseline risk may differ substantially.

judgments.label: External mortality association
judgments.basis: 0.63 is adjusted observational association, not randomized causal effect. The source's primary exposure includes the month after discontinuation; using it for covered time is an approximation.

judgments.label: Causal and population transfer
judgments.basis: 50% jointly discounts residual confounding and transfer to HYA-supported recipients. It is not a measured correction.

judgments.label: Healthy survival per averted death
judgments.basis: 5.1541 reuses the SFAF illustration: utility 0.70, annual hazard 0.08, 15-year horizon and 3% discount. Consistency does not validate transfer to youth; this is not a joint longitudinal medication/survival model.

nullBoundary: No additional medication-covered time or no transferred mortality benefit means no finite price. Positive scenarios are not confidence intervals. Discontinuation risk, adverse effects and repeated recipients require a fuller signed longitudinal model.

fundingRoom.nextEvidence: A priced additional HYA plan, actual fills and coverage days, alternative uptake, clinician capacity and public-versus-private cost allocation; no contact has been made.

overlapBoundary: HYA, GLIDE and HRTC are named subcontractors in the May 2026 proposed SFAF agreement. Prime-only ledgers miss subcontract exposure. This is distinct from the historical $250K/26,016-dose anchor, with no verified supersession crosswalk. Do not add this mortality estimate to full SFAF naloxone benefits for overlapping people.
excluded: Nonfatal morbidity and quality-of-life gains during treatment
